nodeData.note: The latest science and technology worldwide, and the milestones that brought us here.

children.note: What soil and plant microbiology has learned since 2020, explained for farmers and field teams. Each bubble says how mature the idea is and links the paper behind it.

New tools for biological and organic farming: smarter inoculants, better formulations, nano and RNA products, pheromones, drones, DNA tests, digital soil maps and AI apps. Each bubble gives maturity, access in Kenya and India, and cautions.
Key discoveries, pioneers, success stories and failures that shaped biological and organic farming worldwide, with evidence links. Use it to learn what has worked, where, and why.
